description: This file defines the LocalizationAPI class which provides API endpoints for retrieving and updating localization settings such as language and date format in an OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for getting current localization settings and updating them, along with validation rules. It utilizes traits for services and extends a generic Endpoint class implementing a CRUD interface, although only getOne and update are implemented.

classes.name: LocalizationAPI
classes.description: API class for managing localization settings, allowing retrieval and update of language and date format preferences.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch current localization settings such as language and date format.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update localization settings like language and date format.

methods.description: Defines validation rules for the getOne endpoint, excluding ID parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the update endpoint, validating supported languages and date formats.
